clue.text: Least fashionable in Military Intelligence, keeping silence!

indicators.note: in places the word for fashionable inside the abbreviation for the intelligence service

parts.note: in means fashionable, as in the in thing
mum means silence, as in keep mum

explanation.surface: An exclamation that nothing stylish ever comes out of the hush-hush world of army spies.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean the smallest possible amount or degree.

clue.text: National runner sent up for unlawful killing

indicators.note: sent up in a down clue means the word is written upwards, so backwards

parts.note: Red Rum was a racehorse that won the Grand National three times

explanation.surface: A Grand National horse is mocked over a crime.
explanation.walkthrough: The Grand National is Britain's most famous steeplechase.
explanation.definitionFit: Murder is the crime of killing someone unlawfully.

clue.text: From Cochin, a representation of a Hebrew patriarch

indicators.note: a representation of these letters is a rendering of them in a new form, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: An image of an Old Testament elder that comes from an Indian port.
explanation.walkthrough: Cochin is a port in India; 'representation' reorders COCHIN plus A.
explanation.definitionFit: Noachic means relating to Noah, a patriarch of the Bible.

clue.text: It's among the overheads of those bussing at Christmas

definitions.text: It's among the overheads of those bussing at Christmas

parts.words: It's among the overheads of those bussing at Christmas
parts.note: bussing means kissing, and overheads are things hung above, so this is the sprig hung over kissing couples

explanation.surface: Something counted among the costs of running buses during the festive season.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bussing' looks like transport and 'overheads' like business costs; a buss is a kiss, and couples kiss under the plant hung overhead.
explanation.definitionFit: Mistletoe is the plant hung up at Christmas for people to kiss beneath.

clue.text: Realist disposed to support wise men invested with authority

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece supporting another sits below it

parts.note: the Magi were the wise men of the Nativity

indicators.note: disposed means arranged differently, so the letters of realist are reordered

explanation.surface: A down-to-earth person is willing to back the wise and powerful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disposed' turns REALIST into STERIAL, which goes under MAGI.
explanation.definitionFit: Magisterial means having the power and manner of a magistrate or master.

clue.text: A woman among many where French animals are found

indicators.note: among puts the woman and the article inside the letters for many and the French word

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a crossword stand-in for many
ou is the French for where
rib stands for a woman, from Eve being made from Adam's rib

explanation.surface: A lady mingling in a crowd at a place where French creatures live.
explanation.definitionFit: Caribou are North American reindeer, a kind of animal.

clue.text: Organised labour upset and divided

indicators.note: upset in a down clue turns the letters upside down, reading them backwards

parts.note: the TUC is the Trades Union Congress, the British federation of trade unions

explanation.surface: Trade unions are unhappy and split.
explanation.walkthrough: The TUC is the main body of British trade unions.
explanation.definitionFit: To cut something is to divide it into parts.

clue.text: Type of weapon prevalent around Leatherhead

indicators.note: around means the word for prevalent goes round the letter

parts.note: rife means widespread or prevalent
the head of leather is its first letter, L

explanation.surface: Arms are common in a Surrey town.
explanation.walkthrough: Leatherhead is a town in Surrey, but here it is read as 'leather head', the first letter of leather.
explanation.definitionFit: A rifle is a long-barrelled gun, one kind of weapon.

clue.text: Speculator at home, accepting nothing but gold

parts.note: a bull is a stock-market speculator who expects prices to rise

indicators.note: accepting means the word for at home takes the letter inside it

parts.note: in means at home
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A trader sitting at home, willing to take only gold.
explanation.definitionFit: Bullion is gold or silver in bars, before it is made into coins.

clue.text: A Continental firm subject to fluctuations?

parts.note: un is French for a
steady means firm

explanation.surface: A European company whose fortunes go up and down.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unsteady wobbles and varies, never settled.

clue.text: Aiming device that has to be aligned with prudence

definitions.text: Aiming device that has to be aligned with prudence

parts.words: Aiming device that has to be aligned with prudence
parts.note: prudence is foresight, which is also the name of the front sight on a gun; the sight at the back must be lined up with it

explanation.surface: A gun's targeting part that needs to be lined up with caution.
explanation.walkthrough: A rifle has two sights, one at the back and one at the front (the foresight). Prudence is another word for foresight, so the back sight is 'aligned with prudence'.
explanation.definitionFit: The sight at the back of a gun barrel, lined up with the front one to aim.

clue.text: Declines bouts of wrestling

explanation.surface: Someone turns down a few wrestling matches.
explanation.definitionFit: A decline is a drop in level; in wrestling a fall is a pin that settles a bout, and matches are often counted in them.

clue.text: Radical woman changing second 27 for end of 8

indicators.note: changing one letter for another swaps the second E (27, Eastern) in the woman's name for the last letter of 8 down
changing one letter for another swaps the second E (27, Eastern) in the woman's name for the last letter of 8 down

parts.note: Ethel is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A firebrand woman swaps one thing for another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'second 27' is the second E, since 27 across is EASTERN, E for short; 'end of 8' is Y, the last letter of UNSTEADY.
explanation.definitionFit: In chemistry a radical is a group of atoms that acts as a unit; ethyl is one of them.

clue.text: Shiite extremists reach island. about four, giving nothing away

indicators.note: the extremes of a word are its first and last letters, taken here from Shiite
about means the first part goes round the Roman numeral for four

parts.note: Crete is a Greek island
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Fundamentalists land on an island, around four of them, and keep quiet about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reach' is only a link here; the Roman four is wrapped by the island word after the Shiite extremes are joined to it.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone secretive keeps things hidden and reveals nothing.

clue.text: A horse fortunate to have one underfoot

parts.note: a cob is a sturdy short-legged horse
blest means fortunate or lucky

explanation.surface: A lucky horse with one beneath its hoof.
explanation.definitionFit: A cobblestone is a rounded paving stone that people walk on in the street.

clue.text: Various tribes can't read, having unmethodical minds

indicators.note: various means assorted and varied, telling us these letters are rearranged

parts.note: can't taken without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: Different tribes are illiterate and disorganised in their thinking.
explanation.definitionFit: A scatterbrained person is muddled and disorganised in thought.

clue.text: Disturbed characters in Angostura, but legendary sailors

indicators.note: disturbed means thrown into disorder, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Unsettled people in a Venezuelan town, but seafarers of myth.
explanation.walkthrough: Angostura is a town in Venezuela that gave its name to a bitters.
explanation.definitionFit: The Argonauts sailed with Jason in Greek myth to find the Golden Fleece.

clue.text: Purloin a painting

explanation.surface: Steal a picture from the gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: To abstract can mean to take away or steal; an abstract is also a non-representational artwork.

clue.text: One scientist carrying damaged crate for another

indicators.note: carrying means the first scientist holds the shuffled letters inside

parts.note: a biologist is one kind of scientist

indicators.note: damaged means the word crate is broken up and its letters reordered

explanation.surface: A researcher lugging a broken box for a colleague.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One scientist' looks like the definition, but it supplies the container; 'another' is the definition. 'damaged' makes ACTER from the box word.
explanation.definitionFit: A bacteriologist is a different kind of scientist from the first, one who studies germs.

clue.text: Study etiquette, as we should when in Rome?

definitions.text: as we should when in Rome?

parts.note: con means to study or learn by heart
form means proper behaviour, as in good form

explanation.surface: Learn the local manners, as the saying goes for visitors to Rome.
explanation.walkthrough: The proverb is 'when in Rome, do as the Romans do'.
explanation.definitionFit: To conform is to follow local customs, as the proverb about Rome advises.

clue.text: Medical instrument after the doctor's used it, we hear

definitions.text: Medical instrument after the doctor's used it, we hear

parts.words: Medical instrument after the doctor's used it, we hear
parts.note: a doctor flushes out blocked ears with this instrument, after which we can hear

explanation.surface: A medical tool that people talk about once the doctor has finished with it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we hear' looks like a sound-alike signal, but it is literal: ear-syringing clears wax so the patient can hear.
explanation.definitionFit: A syringe is a tube with a plunger used to inject or flush fluid.

clue.text: Office available for a church caretaker

parts.note: Sext is one of the canonical hours, the daily Offices of prayer, said at midday
on means available, as in on tap

explanation.surface: An office job is going for someone to look after a church.
explanation.definitionFit: A sexton looks after a church building and its graveyard.

clue.text: A number of stories about. Conservative graspers

parts.note: ten is a number

indicators.note: about means the stories go round the abbreviation for Conservative

parts.note: tales are stories

explanation.surface: Several tales are told about greedy Tory politicians.
explanation.definitionFit: An octopus's arms grip and seize things, so they are graspers.

clue.text: Become confused and knock top off oar

indicators.note: knock top off means removing the first letter of the word for oar

parts.note: a paddle is a kind of oar

explanation.surface: Get muddled and break the tip off a rowing blade.
explanation.definitionFit: To addle is to muddle, or to become muddled.

clue.text: Scandinavian's choice of directions

parts.note: N is north, a compass direction
or is the word that offers a choice
SE is south-east, another compass direction

explanation.surface: A Nordic person picks which way to go.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the clue as 'N or SE': two directions with a choice between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Norse means relating to old Scandinavia or its people.

clue.text: Purposely miss start of opera featuring in prima donna's come-back?

indicators.note: featuring in means the first letter of opera appears inside the reversed singer
come-back means the word diva is read backwards

parts.note: a prima donna is a diva

indicators.note: start of takes the first letter of opera

explanation.surface: Deliberately skip the opening night of an opera that marks a star soprano's return.
explanation.walkthrough: 'come-back' turns DIVA into AVID, and O goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To avoid something is to keep away from it on purpose.

clue.text: I dn mystery? TV doctor was guilty, some say

indicators.note: some say means the phrase is spoken and the spelling follows the sound

parts.note: the TV doctor is Doctor Who, and was guilty is done it in casual speech

explanation.surface: A mystery puzzle where the television doctor turned out to be the culprit.
explanation.walkthrough: Doctor Who is a long-running BBC science-fiction series; 'Who done it' said aloud gives the word for a detective story.
explanation.definitionFit: A whodunnit is a detective story or crime puzzle.

clue.text: Weather so inclement for a political soft-liner

explanation.surface: Rainy weather suits a moderate politician.
explanation.walkthrough: In British politics a 'wet' was a moderate Conservative opposed to Margaret Thatcher's hard line.
explanation.definitionFit: Rainy weather is wet; a feeble or moderate politician was also called a wet.

clue.text: Storm caused by 27 member interrupting trial

indicators.note: interrupting means the letters break into the word for trial

parts.note: a test is a trial
27 across is EASTERN, abbreviated E
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Trouble stirred up by a politician from one region breaking into a court case.
explanation.walkthrough: Cross-references are common in older puzzles: 27 here stands for its answer, abbreviated to its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A tempest is a violent storm.

clue.text: Flower in heart of Kent, like Dryden's blooming bride

indicators.note: in puts the flower inside the centre letters of Kent
the heart of a word is its middle letters

parts.note: an aster is a flower

explanation.surface: A flower grown in the middle of Kent, as fresh as a poet's bride.
explanation.walkthrough: Kent is a county in south-east England; its middle letters are EN. Dryden wrote of an 'eastern bride', the Orient being a byword for beauty.
explanation.definitionFit: Dryden described a bride in full bloom as eastern, meaning oriental in her beauty.
